title: Physical content of the spectral filter and embeddable spectrum
html: The physical content of the Skein resolution acts as a projection onto the submodule spanned by knots with g(K) \leq 4. The Descartes universe does not arbitrarily select particles; every topologically admissible knot type is physically realizable. The Skein algebra applied to the 7 generators spans the entire embeddable spectrum, allowing higher-crossing embeddable knots to appear as massive, short-lived resonances.
